title: Rust Native Documentation Plugin
description: Configures the observation, request policy, execution, runtime, conditional registration control, and SDK executor groups demonstrated by the native example.

tag.description: Non-empty label attached to plugin-created metadata and runtime events.

observe.description: Controls the subscriber and observability-only event, tool, and LLM sanitizers.

enabled.description: Registers the subscriber and event, tool, and LLM observability sanitizers.

redact_keys.description: Object keys whose observability values are replaced recursively.

requests.description: Controls tool and model blocking plus real request rewriting.

enabled.description: Registers tool and model policy plus request-rewriting middleware.

mode.description: Blocks configured tool and model names in enforce mode; permits them in observe mode.

blocked_tools.description: Exact tool names rejected in enforce mode.

blocked_models.description: Exact model names rejected in enforce mode.

header_name.description: Header name added to the real LLM request.

header_value.description: Header value added to the real LLM request.

priority.description: Priority for the tool and LLM request intercepts.

break_chain.description: Stops later request intercepts after this component rewrites a request.

execution.description: Controls tool, unary LLM, and streaming LLM continuation wrappers.

enabled.description: Registers tool, unary LLM, and streaming LLM execution intercepts.

priority.description: Priority for all three execution intercepts.

emit_pending_marks.description: Adds Relay-owned pending marks to tool execution and LLM request outcomes.

runtime.description: Controls host runtime marks, child scopes, and isolated scope-stack demonstration.

emit_marks.description: Emits a host-runtime mark during the tool request intercept.

emit_isolated_scope.description: Creates, binds, and drops an isolated scope stack during the tool request intercept.

registration_control.description: Optionally suppresses a matching global runtime registration for this component's activation lifetime.

enabled.description: Registers the activation-owned conditional middleware guardrail.

kinds.description: Non-empty set of runtime registration kinds eligible for suppression.

registration_name.description: Effective name of the global registration to suppress. When registration control is enabled, this value must differ from allowed_registration_name.

allowed_registration_name.description: Effective name of the global registration that the example's second callback explicitly leaves enabled. When registration control is enabled, this value must differ from registration_name.

reason.description: Non-empty reason returned by the callback while the registration is suppressed.

executor.description: SDK-owned Tokio executor settings for this configured native component.

worker_threads.description: Positive number of executor workers. The example defaults to two.
